Do not use the bridge on that account before then. Evidence already found 2026-11-08 (start from it, verify, do not just repeat): same message 'Due to violation of user policies, your account has been suspended until <date>' reported by users of third-party DeepSeek web tools: github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/issues/16972 (cookie web-session relay; maintainers say DeepSeek anti-abuse flags unofficial web sessions, advise the official API), github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek/issues/186 and #229 (many duplicates; owner's test: the same request repeated fast, many new chats and heavy regenerate trigger it; agent-like heavy use, MCP and bridges suspected, anecdotal; some suspensions look like false positives in a wider wave), github.com/sebattfg/ZeroScript-Free/issues/82 (extension, 3 day suspension after a night of use) and #115. So far no source names the exact trigger; every cause stays unproved. The official API is the sanctioned channel for automation.
